verdicts.rationale: Both members identical title/author/year/DOI (Anderson & Khang 2010, scission in perception of color and opacity).
Both 'Optimality Theoretic Semantics', Hendriks & de Hoop, same DOI and fields; the dehoop1999papers citekey label is misleading but its fields describe the 2001 paper.
Identical fields, Andrews 2020 'Understanding animal behavior', shared DOI.
Angrist, Imbens & Rubin 1996, identical title/authors/DOI/pages.
Ankrum & Palmer 1991 'Memory for objects and parts', identical fields and DOI.
Anscombre & Ducrot 1977 'Deux mais en français?', identical fields and DOI.
Appel 1967 quantitative invisibility, identical title/author/DOI; one has extra note only.
Apresjan 'Regular Polysemy', same DOI/title/author/volume; one lacks pages but clearly the same work.
Arditi, Holtzman & Kosslyn 1988, identical title/authors/DOI/pages.
Arguin & Saumier 2004, identical fields and DOI.
Argyle 'Bodily Communication', Methuen; members are 1st (1975) and 2nd (1988) editions of the same book — same work.
Ariew, Cummins & Perlman 2002 'Functions', OUP; second member merely omits the author field.
Boynton, Ciaramitaro & Arman 2006, identical title/authors/DOI/pages.
Armstrong 1981 'The nature of mind', Harvester; one typed book, other incollection, same work.
Moore & Armstrong 2003 'Selective gating of visual signals', Nature, identical fields and DOI.
Josh Armstrong 2016 'The problem of lexical innovation', identical fields and DOI.
Arnheim 'Art and Visual Perception', UC Press; members are 1954 original and 1974 revised edition of the same book.
Ashby 1956 'An introduction to cybernetics', identical fields.
Asher & Lascarides 1998 'Questions in Dialogue', identical fields and DOI.
Asher 1998 'The semantics and pragmatics of presupposition', identical fields and DOI.
Lascarides & Asher 'Agreement, Disputes and Commitments in Dialogue', all three share DOI, title, authors, volume, and pages; misleading citekeys but same work.
Atkinson & Heritage 'Structures of Social Action', Cambridge, identical fields.
Atlas 1979 'How Linguistics Matters to Philosophy: Presupposition, Truth, and Meaning', same DOI/title/author/pages.
Attneave 1954 'Some informational aspects of visual perception', all three share DOI, title, author, volume, pages.
Attneave 1968 'Triangles as Ambiguous Figures', identical fields and DOI.
